sources.title: Seed-Evolving — official model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact doubao-seed-evolving rolling endpoint; September 9, 2026 revision. Lists 1024k context, text/image/video understanding, text generation, deep thinking, and function calling; no audio understanding. Full public Markdown fetched directly on the review date.

sources.title: Model release announcements — 2026
sources.evidence: The 202606 section marks doubao-seed-evolving as newly released by ByteDance in the Seed family. July lists the 1M-context upgrade; subsequent entries are updates under the same model ID. No initial release day is given.

sources.title: Doubao model service agreement, effective September 23, 2026
sources.evidence: Applies to the Doubao model service. Sections 1.2 and 2 restrict the service license; sections 5.1–5.2 retain model ownership and state that algorithms, parameters, and source code are not provided.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card: Agentic Intelligence for Productivity
sources.evidence: Downloaded the official portfolio-linked PDF and searched its full extracted text. Describes Seed2.1 Turbo and Pro; contains no exact Seed-Evolving model specification or total/active parameter or production-architecture disclosure that can be assigned to Evolving.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity (June 30, 2026)
sources.evidence: Downloaded and searched this later first-party model card, including comparison material. No exact Seed-Evolving entry or parameter/architecture specification found; sibling model details are not transferred.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Officially Released: Advancing AI Productivity
sources.evidence: Dated June 23, 2026, but announces Seed2.1 without naming Seed-Evolving; therefore it does not substantiate the baseline exact day for Evolving.

sources.title: ByteDance Seed publications
sources.evidence: Checked the current first-page publication index through October 25, 2026, alongside exact-model searches for technical reports, training and interpretability disclosures. No exact-model architecture or parameter disclosure was located; this is a bounded search, not proof of absence.

name.note: Official name Seed-Evolving; baseline spacing is a normalized display name.

developer.note: The exact-model release entry names ByteDance as provider.

family.note: Official description places the model in the Seed series.

release_date.note: Initial release is explicitly listed under June 2026; June 23 is supported for Seed2.1, not this exact rolling model. Retain month precision.

open_weights.note: Hosted Doubao service; section 5.2 expressly says model parameters and source code are not provided.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the restricted commercial service license; no open-weight grant.

parameters_b.note: No exact-model total count disclosed in the accessed official docs or checked first-party cards; no estimate or sibling count used.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-model active parameter count disclosed; cannot derive it from total size or assume a dense model.

architecture.note: No exact-model architecture found in official docs, first-party cards, or targeted training/interpretability searches; Transformer, dense and MoE remain unasserted.

context_window.note: Current rolling endpoint documentation says 1024k tokens, normalized with decimal k; July 2026 announcement records the 1M upgrade from the older specification.

modalities.note: Explicit text/image/video understanding and text generation; audio input is explicitly unsupported.

reasoning.note: Deep thinking is supported and enabled by default.

tool_call.note: Function calling is supported with dedicated tool-call usage guidance.

description.value: Continuously updated Seed model for reasoning, coding, task planning, tool calling, and image and video understanding.
description.note: Plain summary of supported capabilities and the rolling update mechanism.

patch.description: Continuously updated Seed model for reasoning, coding, task planning, tool calling, and image and video understanding.
patch.notes: Rolling doubao-seed-evolving endpoint: specifications reflect the official card accessed October 26, 2026, whose stated model revision is September 9, 2026. Initial release is documented only to June 2026; the July entry is a context upgrade. Total and active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed in the checked primary sources.

summary: Correct context from 256000 to the currently documented 1024k tokens; reduce unsupported June 23 precision to June 2026; classify the service license as proprietary and replace the description with supported capabilities. Confirm text/image/video input, text output, reasoning and tools. Total/active parameters and architecture remain null after exact-model searches and checks of first-party model cards.
